out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Proper Temp
violations.observation: The following food item(s) was not reheated for hot holding to a sufficient temperature and/or time: leftover rice reheated in warmer to 146f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding shall be reheated to a minimum temperature of 165F for 15 seconds. CDI reheated to over 170f.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: all items on service line 43f -52f. Employees placed on cold wells without turning them on.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI items returned to WIC to cool

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: cooling cooked vegetables in cooling wells.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI vegetables placed in WIC to cool properly.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located over the prep table and hand sink where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. CDI removed.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited in Toilet Rooms
violations.observation: Food storage in toilet rooms. Observed drinks stored in toilet room.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored in toilet rooms. CDI Removed.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit Suspension for Imminent Health Hazard
violations.observation: The establishment has been closed and the permit to operate suspended due to the following imminent health hazard: Inadequate refrigeration to protect product.
violations.corrective_action: The establishment shall remain closed until ALL violations relative to the imminent health hazard cited in the inspection report have been corrected. A follow-up inspection shall be conducted to ensure the imminent health hazard has been eliminated. Please notify me when the violations are corrected. You may not operate until the Health Department reinstates the permit to operate.

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Food Safety
violations.observation: Employees are not properly trained in food safety, including food allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. CFM unaware of cooling time frames, cold holding temperatures, toxicity of mixing sanitizer with bleach, TCS food items and calibrating thermometers.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train all his/her employees in food safety, including allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. CDI EHS discussed these safety food topics

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: tomato’s, lettuce, kale, hummus and chickpea salad did not cool in 4 hours
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CDI discarded

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: WIC at 59f all food above 47f, all items on cold holding table 47f or higher.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI discarded

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: The quat and bleach are not being used in accordance with law or the manufacturer's use directions. Observed CFM mix quat into bleach water in the sink which can create a toxic gas.
violations.corrective_action: Poisonous and toxic materials shall be used according to law and per the manufacturer's directions to prevent injury and contamination. CDI solution poured down the drain.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: cooling food in broken WIC and on cold holding table which is not designed for cooling.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI discussed cooling and moved non-compromised food to working cooler to cool.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sauces in squirt bottles without labels.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WIC at 59f.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solution for bleach being used in the sink and sanitizer buckets.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: The operator is not testing the chemical sanitizing solution to ensure proper concentration of the solution.
violations.corrective_action: The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device. YAFA GRILL (Inspection Date: 11/03/2025) Page 2 of 3
